entities.name: Josef Sloup-Štaplík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josef Sloup known as Štaplík was a Czechoslovak football goalkeeper. He played 16 games for the Czechoslovakia national football team. He represented Czechoslovakia at the 1924 Olympics. His older brother Rudolf was also a footballer.
